correctness.rationale: A partial-matching expansion and Eisenstein valuation table prove every 8-by-8 cubic-root permanent is 9 times a nonzero algebraic integer, hence modulus at least nine. Explicit 8-by-8 exponent witness has direct 40,320-permutation phase count (13446,13437,13437), proving permanent nine. Two independent exact integer 6,561-word circulant enumerations agree on minimum squared norm1296, precisely 48 minimizers and 59 distinct squared values. Diagonalization gives exact stated inversion norms.

value.rationale: The least modulus is the sharp inverse norm for ternary permutation-code deconvolution. The 8-by-8 case is a canonical nonvanishing p^2-1 threshold. Circulant Fourier frequencies are natural under simultaneous cyclic row/column shifts, and the exact factor-four symmetry-constrained improvement is mathematically informative beyond an unstructured finite table; attainment and exact multiplicity are not delivered by prior zero-free arguments.
